speaker: john_heminges
text: The boxes are open. Pennies, half-groats, threepences, a few sixpences, and one clipped shilling. Margery swears she never took it. I am not calling her back to swear it again. The swear is already in the count.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave her the swear. She said her yard on Thursday, and once was the right number of times.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: My hand is on the lid, if anyone wants a witness that the silver was in the box. I unlock. I do not orate. The heap can speak for itself better than a son of the house.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item. A crown new gilt, three shillings.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item. Rosemary, and a black pall for the coffin, fourteen pence.

speaker: john_heminges
text: And a looking-glass at four shillings, bought in May and not yet looked in.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The glass is in the chest, where I locked it on Thursday. Looking in it was not the play's business. The four shillings are May's. May can keep them. I am not mixing a mirror with a gilt crown to make a neater bill.

speaker: james_burbage
text: A house that takes eleven pound of a Thursday is a house worth a landlord's envy.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Not the lease, Father. Not today. Envy is not an offer, and I will not spend a good week bargaining with a mood.

speaker: james_burbage
text: I said envy. I did not say a price. Steer, if you are steering. I can admire a Thursday without buying the ground under it, and I would like that distinction entered, since everything else in this room is entered.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Let him admire it, and let the admiration stay admiration. Some of that eleven pound had my knees in it. I am not a lease, and I am not for sale to the man who owns the dirt.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The galleries this week come to more than the whole house took in a June week. I have no June figure on this baize. I will not invent one so that a true week can have a neighbour. More is the word. More will have to do.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Eleven pound six, and not a line of it mine. I'd have Sweet Master Shakespeare learn to empty a house. It's the rarer art.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I had rather a house filled, and I said so yesterday in another form. Today I am here for a share. I will take it without improving your philosophy or my own.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Kemp's interest in the king: nothing, there being nowhere to put it. In the jig I do not tally. It is all interest and no principal.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then the jig is my estate, and nobody tallies an estate that laughs. I can live on interest when the principal is a king who will not have me. You, Master Shakespeare, still owe the town one empty afternoon. I am patient. I am not quiet about it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The hired men are paid their ten shillings. That is their wage for the week. It is not a piece cut off Thursday's box. A wage and a share are different creatures, and I will not cross them on the page to seem exact.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then do not cross them. Ten shillings is what they are paid. If the share is forty-five, forty-five is what a sharer takes. I can hear both and marry neither.

speaker: john_heminges
text: It comes to forty-five shillings a share. The best week of the year. I am saying the share. I am not saying it is a slice of one afternoon. An afternoon was eleven pound six. A week is the week, after the wage and the house. Anyone who wants a third figure may do his arithmetic in the street.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Forty-five. I have known worse endings than a week that lands there. Richard, the king. Once a week, or the town will decide Thursday was an accident and stay at home to prove it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: It will be.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Tuesday next, then Thursday the sixteenth. A changing day, so the bill does not go stale. Once a week. Not twice, unless the yard begs, and the yard may beg to Abel.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Tuesday next. Thursday the sixteenth. I can hang both. I will not hang the king twice in one week to please a rumour, and I will not hang Kemp inside it to please Kemp.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Hang me where the jig is. I have no quarrel with a changing day, so long as the change does not smuggle me into a chronicle. Sweet Master Shakespeare may keep his rare art. I will keep the dance, which pays in noise, and noise is a coin John does not have to clip.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: The silver is what it is. I am taking my hand off the lid. Father, the envy walks home with you. It is not staying here to become a negotiation with a landlord who is not in the room.

speaker: james_burbage
text: It will walk. I know when I am steered. I do not have to love the reins. Forty-five shillings is a good week. Eleven pound of a Thursday was a good afternoon. I am allowed both sentences before I am hushed, and I have had them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Say both. I am entering the forty-five as they stand. I have no jest that would make them truer, and I am not spending one for the company's comfort.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then enter them. It will be Tuesday, and it will be the sixteenth, and the glass can stay unlooked-in until there is a use for a mirror that is not a cut scene. I am done being envied for one day.

speaker: john_heminges
text: He enters his own line. I am not writing it for him. The clipped shilling stays clipped. Margery's swear stands without a second performance. The baize is clear. God keep you. James, keep the envy on a short lead. It suits you shorter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: God keep you, John. The forty-five are in my hand. The book can have them without a joke. That is as much restraint as the week has earned from me, and I am spending all of it.
